topics.title: Stern Show Zoo Chaos & Morton Downey
topics.summary: During a Stern Show segment, the New York Zoo is destroyed as callers make outlandish claims about earnings and money, accuse others of fraud, and engage in bizarre behavior like peeing in decanters. Guests discuss selling the show for $15 per copy while Morton Downey complains about being stiffed on a deal involving urine.

topics.title: Morton's Fabricated Claims
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts relentlessly mock Morton Downey Jr.'s outlandish and often contradictory claims about his past – including fabricated stories of being an FBI informant, operating a limo service with unusual trade deals, and having celebrity relationships. They highlight the absurdity of his attempts to construct a glamorous life while exposing his dishonesty.

topics.title: Morton Downey Jr.'s Failed Ventures
topics.summary: Following a failed TV show, Morton Downey Jr. pursued various ventures including consulting fees, a real estate company (Genesis), motivational speaking engagements, and attempts at a singing career. He repeatedly made contradictory claims about these projects, leading to questions regarding his credibility and often shifting narratives.

topics.title: Morton Downey Jr.'s Bizarre Claims
topics.summary: During a lengthy discussion, Morton Downey Jr. repeatedly claims he was an FBI agent involved in the evergreen goldmine scam while detailing bizarre incidents like peeing in his limo and shaving his head with marital disputes. He insists on owning his limo despite numerous complications and accusations from former associates, further claiming to have been fired for consulting with a matrimonial attorney regarding a divorce.”} ظهرةً في هذا الملف: {

topics.title: Former Assistant Confronts Employer on Air
topics.summary: A former assistant calls into a radio show to confront her former employer, a man named Mort, about being fired with no notice and without severance. The conversation escalates as Mort denies wrongdoing and makes derogatory comments about the assistant's health and work performance.

topics.title: Morton Downey Jr. Confronts Former Secretary
topics.summary: Radio host confronts his former employee Missy over workplace disputes, including accusations about absences, undisclosed FBI work, and a disputed marriage. The two argue about employment termination, compensation, and various workplace incidents without resolving their disagreements.
